title: Open Souq (classifieds) — browser test report
area: Open Souq: website, Seller Center classified shop, Creator Studio broker
summary: Playwright browser test of Open Souq end to end: guest browsing (categories, search and filters, motors, real estate list and map view, ad and property detail with the financing block, shop and broker pages, compare, Arabic RTL), buyer flows (favourites, saved searches, chat, D12 viewing / reserve requests with the D13 mail rule, show phone behind the buyer contract, report), posting as a private customer (wizard, photos, per-category photo limit, video, seller contract, My ads edit / pause / resume / sold / renew / archive), the classified shop in Seller Center (2FA, all 11 sidebar pages, posting with coordinates, lifecycle, requests list, inquiry replies) and the broker in Creator Studio (all 19 sidebar pages, requests, leads pipeline, special requests). 29 tests: 27 passed, 2 failed. The two failures are bugs already fixed in the storefront code that need a production rebuild. Six issues found: four fixed in code, one dev-environment fix, one open.
environment: Storefront http://localhost:3000 (next start, production build — not rebuilt during this run)
API + Blade panels http://localhost:8000; panels on {partner|marketer|admin}.nawy.test:8000 (Chromium host-resolver-rules)
Dev databases, MAIL_MAILER=log (mails read from backend/storage/logs/laravel.log), uae-en / uae-ar markets
Playwright project 'areas', Desktop Chrome, 2 workers, E2E_SKIP_SEED=1 --no-deps
Test records: e2e/specs/areas/souq/support/setup.php (idempotent, run through artisan tinker): classified shop, broker, contract category, 2-photo category, three live ads

issues.description: A classified shop (membership vendor:classified) got no panel country: PanelCountries only counted product-vendor memberships on the partner panel, so the vendor workspace never resolved — the shop saw the product-seller sidebar and a bare 'Your access' dashboard, and every Marketplace page (My listings, Post a listing, Inquiries, Requests) answered 403.
issues.fix: backend/app/Domains/Panels/Support/PanelCountries.php counts ProductVendor and ClassifiedSeller memberships; Pest regression in tests/Feature/VerticalPanelsTest.php (request starts without a country context). Live (PHP).

issues.description: My ads linked every title to the public ad page, but only live ads have one: drafts / ads in review opened 'We couldn't find that page' and the link prefetch logged a 404 in the console.
issues.fix: features/classifieds/account.tsx links only active ads; vitest tests/features/my-ads-links.test.tsx. Needs a storefront rebuild (SOQ-20 fails until then).

issues.description: A WebM recorded in a browser (MediaRecorder, also many Android recorders) has no duration in its header (duration = Infinity), so the wizard refused it with 'We couldn't read this video'.
issues.fix: features/classifieds/photo-limits.ts readVideoDuration seeks to the end to read the real duration (bounded timeout); verified in Chromium (Infinity → 1.38 s); vitest in tests/features/classified-photo-limits.test.ts. Needs a storefront rebuild (SOQ-19 fails until then).

issues.description: An ad page that was rendered while the ad was live keeps answering HTTP 200 (with the not-found body and noindex) after the ad is archived; never-live numbers answer 404. Looks like the route-level render cache of the production build.
issues.fix: Not fixed (Next.js caching behaviour; noindex limits the SEO impact).

issues.description: Latitude, longitude and price inputs were type=number without step, so the browser refused decimal coordinates (25.14) and the form could not be submitted with a map location.
issues.fix: resources/views/panels/partner/marketplace/create.blade.php step="any" with min/max; Pest regression in tests/Feature/VerticalPanelsTest.php. Live (Blade).

issues.description: backend/public/storage symlink was missing, so every public-disk image (ad photos) answered 403 and showed as broken in the storefront.
issues.fix: Ran php artisan storage:link (git-ignored symlink; dev setup step, not documented in the run guide).

notes: Pages covered: Seller Center classified layout 11/11 sidebar pages (the brief counted 12; PanelNavigation lists 11 for classified shops); Creator Studio broker 19/19 sidebar pages including the 4 broker pages; website Open Souq pages classified, classified/search, classified/find/[number], classified/post, classified/compare, classified/shop/[slug], property, property?view=map, property/[number], brokers/[slug], account/my-ads, account/favourites, account/saved-searches, account/inquiries (Chats + Requests tabs), account/special-requests.

D12 verified: viewing / reserve requests carry name, email, phone, preferred time and message only; no status and no actions on the website list, Seller Center and Creator Studio lists. D13 verified in the mail log: the advertiser gets one 'Viewing / Reserve request for …' mail; the customer gets none.
Financing block: shown on the property ad (property vertical). The dev 'motors' / 'cars-for-sale' categories have vertical 'general', so car ads show no financing card — category data, not code.
Phone reveal on a shop ad uses the ad's contact phone, else the owner user's phone; the shop's own contact phone is not a fallback ('The seller prefers chat' when both are empty). Noted, not changed.
A classified shop can still open product-seller URLs such as /orders directly (empty pages); the sidebar hides them. Noted, not changed.

Exclusive contracts are granted by the admin (Admin → Real estate); brokers have no page for them in Creator Studio, so the broker side cannot be tested beyond its ads; admin side is covered by the admin report.

Not testable in dev: real MP4/MOV uploads (Playwright Chromium has no H.264/HEVC decoder, so a WebM recorded in the page was used); listing expiry by time (simulated by setting the test ad to expired); paid boosts / republish packages (renewal price is 0 in dev, so Renew is free).
The storefront was not rebuilt (shared production build): SOQ-19 and SOQ-20 fail until 'npm run build' + restart; then they should pass.
